scope: Google write permit post-dispatch finalization failure boundary
implementation: A failed finalize after provider success returns GoogleWriteOutcomeUnknownError with GBP_WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.
A failed finalize after ambiguous or definitive provider failure returns the same safe outcome marker.
Finalize and provider dispatch remain single-shot; raw provider and database failure details are not exposed.
The grant remains durably dispatched when finalization fails and is not falsely reported as terminalized.
